parallels.note: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures…

translations.web: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
translations.bsb: It is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”
translations.kjv: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
translations.asv: It is like unto leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.
